# incident-controller — LLM doc index (unreleased)
# One line per file; pin the version on release.
docs/overview.md: what an Incident is, its lifecycle, who writes what, Run apply, the provider-runtime mapping
docs/api.md: the Incident and IncidentApply CRDs field by field, field ownership, the enforced rules
docs/configuration.md: controller flags, chart values, check pod RBAC and network policy
main.go: the manager: flags, cache scoped to the checks namespace, controller setup
internal/controllers/incident/machine.go: the state machine
internal/controllers/incident/incident.go: the provider-runtime external client (Observe/Create/Update/Delete)
internal/controllers/incident/checkpod.go: the check and apply pods, their script ConfigMap and the apply kubeconfig Secret
internal/controllers/incident/apply.go: the IncidentApply's provider-runtime external client: admission, the run as the requester, the TTL
check/Dockerfile: the check pod image (bash, kubectl, jq)
helm/incident-controller/values.yaml: the controller chart values
apis/incident/v1alpha1/types.go: the Incident Go types, source of truth for its CRD
apis/incident/v1alpha1/incidentapply_types.go: the IncidentApply Go types
helm/incident-controller-crds/templates/incidentapply-requested-by.yaml: the admission policy that writes spec.requestedBy
helm/incident-controller-crds/templates/observability.krateo.io_incidents.yaml: the generated Incident CRD
examples/incident/README.md: a resolved Incident, step by step
examples/incident/incident.yaml: the sample Incident
examples/incidentapply/README.md: one Run apply click, step by step
